coverage.heading: Notice review rule
coverage.evidence: The source identifies one notice-review rule.
The ordinary review minimum is 30 calendar days.
The 10-day path is conditioned on expedited treatment, explicit request, and recorded written consent.
A notice below the selected threshold is non-compliant.
Missing consent is retained as missing and is not inferred from the expedited flag.

transformations: The source paragraph was separated into a base threshold, a conditioned exception, a comparison rule, and an evidence prohibition.
The candidate returns the selected path and evidence state so reviewers can distinguish default and exception reasoning.
No source claim was generalized into automatic applicability, jurisdiction, or external evidence verification.
